Data & Storage
Everything you enter autosaves every few seconds to this browser's local storage only. There is no shared backend in this build — data does not sync between computers or team members.

Preconstruction Process
The exact phases and steps every project runs through, in order — this drives the Next Required Action on every project's Overview tab. Edit titles, reassign roles, reorder, add, or remove steps here whenever the real process changes; nothing about the process is hardcoded.
Default Assignee by Role
Who usually fills each role — pre-fills the "Assigned To" field on a project's next step, but can always be changed per project.
Default Task Assignees
Client-Facing Phase Descriptions
Plain-language descriptions clients see under their schedule, instead of the internal task checklist — one time setup, applies to every project.
Team Roster
Add, edit, or remove team members — including their role and location — from Users & Permissions. Everyone Active there shows up in every "Assigned To" dropdown across Sales and Preconstruction.
Standard Schedule Template
Typical duration for each phase, in business days. This is what "Generate Standard Schedule" uses to fill in every milestone's due date automatically on a project, instead of typing each one in by hand.
